tool_input.description: Probe ArrayUtils.toString/isSameType/toStringArray behavior with a scratch program

result: All 47 tests pass (this is the only `*AgentTest.java` in the project). I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ArrayUtilsAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `ArrayUtils`: happy paths plus boundary/error cases (null arrays, out-of-range indices throwing `IndexOutOfBoundsException`, `NullPointerException` on unboxing nulls, empty arrays, negative/overflow offsets for `swap`/`shift`/`subarray`, `toMap` malformed-entry error, etc.).
